coachAM: Your journal reveals a founder constantly chasing an external ideal – "lock in young," "best worker, best seller, charismatic" – while your core physical and mental foundations are crumbling; the "Instagram, games, loop scrolling" you identify as a distraction in your own words is directly sabotaging your sleep and training, making sustained elite performance impossible. This relentless pursuit of an outward persona without inward discipline is the root cause, creating a critical disconnect between your declared intentions and your embodied reality, which will inevitably cap your growth and impact. Today, before anything else, configure your phone to automatically shut down all social media and entertainment apps at 9:00 PM.
